description:
Welcome to the Audio Radar Affiliate Program! 

Dear Affiliate Partner, We're thrilled to have you on board as a valued member of the Audio Radar affiliate program. 

Audio Radar is a groundbreaking gaming peripheral designed to enhance the gaming experience for all players, including those who are d/Deaf or hard-of-hearing (HOH), by enabling them to "see the sound" in video games. 

Key Points about Audio Radar: 

  1. Enhanced Situational Awareness: Audio Radar provides visual cues that indicate the direction and intensity of in-game sounds. This allows gamers to make faster, more informed decisions, improving their gameplay and reaction times. 
  2. Inclusivity for Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing Gamers: By allowing users to "see" in-game sounds, Audio Radar levels the playing field for d/Deaf and HOH gamers, offering them a more immersive and competitive gaming experience. 
  3. Customization Options: Gamers can personalize their experience with customizable lighting behaviors, colors, and channel sensitivity. Audio Radar adapts to various modes like gaming and streaming, allowing users to create the perfect setup for their needs. 
  4. Promotes Good Hearing Health: With Audio Radar, gamers can lower their audio levels without missing crucial sound cues, helping to protect their hearing and promote a healthier gaming environment. 
  5. Dynamic Lighting for Streamers and Content Creators: Audio Radar also functions as a customizable lighting studio with 16.8 million colors, ideal for streamers and content creators who want to create professional-looking content. 

Compatibility and Ease of Use: Works with Xbox, PlayStation, and PC (any gaming system using HDMI for sound/video). 

Compatible with any game utilizing accurate directional sound (2.1, 5.1, 7.1 surround sound). 

Can connect to displays ranging from 24" gaming monitors to 85"+ TVs (may require extended cables). 

Top Games to Showcase Audio Radar: 

Minecraft
Audio Radar’s MOD for Minecraft helps distinguish between sounds like footsteps and gunshots, or creepers versus sheep. Minecraft Mod Instructions: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1doDLHG4s2xzw6xxKu4TOIua0BFcrxdV0?usp=sharing 

PUBG 
Audio Radar enhances the gaming experience with precise sound direction, perfect for identifying gunshots and vehicles. 

COD Warzone 
Utilize Audio Radar's 7.1 channels to pinpoint sounds, like loot crates above or footsteps around you. 

RUST 
Audio Radar is especially useful in survival games with proximity chat, like RUST, allowing players to discern conversation direction. 

Other Popular Titles 
ARC: Survival Ascended, Fortnite, Valorant, Sons of the Forest, and many more. 

About Airdrop Gaming: Founded in 2012 by Tim Murphy, a former radar technician in the U.S. Navy, Airdrop Gaming has always been dedicated to enhancing the gaming experience. 

Our flagship product, Audio Radar, was born from Tim's passion for gaming accessibility and his expertise in radar technology. Officially launched in December 2023, Audio Radar has received rave reviews with an average rating of 4.75 out of 5 stars. 

We’re excited to start shipping Audio Radar worldwide starting July 1st, 2024. We see Audio Radar as the future of gaming accessibility, with ambitions to become the "ASL of the video game industry." 

Our vision includes collaborating with game developers to integrate the Audio Radar SDK, making games more accessible for everyone. 

We’re here to support you every step of the way. Please don’t hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or need assistance in promoting Audio Radar. 

Thank you for joining us on this journey to make gaming more inclusive and immersive for all. 

Best regards, 

Tim Murphy 

Founder and CEO | Airdrop Gaming | Audio Radar

Welcome to AudioRadar! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.

6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: tim@airdropgaming.com.

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to tim@airdropgaming.com for support.
